name: siak-ufd-frontend
description: SIAK UFD Enterprise SaaS Web Client

scripts.start: node -e "const http=require('http'),fs=require('fs'),path=require('path');http.createServer((req,res)=>{let f=path.join(__dirname,req.url.split('?')[0]);if(f.endsWith('/')||!path.extname(f))f=path.join(f,'index.html');fs.readFile(f,(err,data)=>{if(err){res.writeHead(404);res.end('Not Found');}else{let ext=path.extname(f);let type='text/html';if(ext==='.css')type='text/css';else if(ext==='.js')type='application/javascript';else if(ext==='.json')type='application/json';else if(ext==='.svg')type='image/svg+xml';res.writeHead(200,{'Content-Type':type});res.end(data);}});}).listen(3000,()=>console.log('Frontend Web Client running at http://localhost:3000'));"

author: Universitas Fatmawati Digital
